purpose: Supervised adaptation of OmniArch Base for pressure-driven pipe and channel flow
precision: GPU float32 for every model in this paired experiment; previous default-bfloat16 results preserved separately
trainable: 1D decoder plus a 1->32->1024 time-step conditioner; separate adapters for pipe/channel; pretrained encoder/Transformer frozen
plain: physical velocity input, data loss only, no boundary projection
specialized: U*=G*a^2/mu scaling, data loss + discrete CN residual + pipe-axis derivative penalty, zero wall projection; no analytic-profile output ansatz
small_baseline: geometry-specific 1D CNN with 10 frames, coordinates, dtau and grid spacing; same data, physics loss, boundary projection and steps
checkpoint_selection: lowest mean 20-frame relative L2 on the complete held-out validation set; tests evaluated only after training is complete
timing: two warmups, seven repeats, batch=1, 20 steps; loading/history generation excluded; model compute/data transfer included
limits: Forecasting specialization only, not direct parameter-to-steady-BVP solution. Similarity preprocessing has added known physical scale metadata. Geometry is supplied by adapter selection. No claim of pretrained-backbone benefit without a random-backbone control.
